title: Career Roadmap · Lineman
summary: A Lineman installs, maintains and repairs overhead or underground electrical distribution lines, poles, cables and related equipment, helping deliver electricity safely to homes, businesses and industries.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 → Relevant ITI electrical trade → Apprenticeship / supervised field training → Utility recruitment → Lineman / Line Technician → Senior Technician / Supervisor, subject to eligibility and authorization.

blocks.label: Entry route
blocks.text: Class 10 is a common starting point for relevant ITI trades; confirm the specific course and recruitment rules.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Science, basic electricity and technical drawing.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Electrical distribution, cables, transformers, line equipment and electrical safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Physical fitness, teamwork, attention to detail, discipline and following safety procedures.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Utility recruitment may specify age, medical fitness, education, trade certificates and other conditions.

items.text: ITI Electrician → Electrical installation, equipment maintenance and fault diagnosis.
ITI Electrician – Power Distribution → Training relevant to distribution systems and electrical-network work.
ITI Wireman → Wiring and electrical installation skills; acceptance for lineman roles depends on the recruitment notice.
Apprenticeship / utility field training → Practical experience under qualified supervision.

blocks.text: DGT lists Electrician – Power Distribution as a two-year CTS trade with Class 10 Science and Mathematics or equivalent as the stated entry route. This is a relevant option, but each employer decides which qualifications it accepts.

blocks.text: Check current affiliation, exact trade availability, course duration and admissions in the NCVT MIS ITI directory. These are training options, not a ranking.

blocks.label: National / state
blocks.text: National Scholarship Portal and Andhra Pradesh scholarship services for eligible ITI students.

blocks.label: Skill development
blocks.text: Check government-funded training and approved state skill-development programmes.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: Stipends may apply under the registered apprenticeship contract; confirm current terms.

blocks.label: Eligibility
blocks.text: Depends on the scheme, institute, income, category, domicile and course.
Verify current official notification; no universal percentage cutoff applies.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Electrical fundamentals, tools, measurement, wiring diagrams and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Distribution systems, cables, earthing, transformers, protection and fault-finding.

blocks.label: Field training
blocks.text: Learn pole and line equipment inspection, maintenance procedures and emergency response under qualified supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Distribution-network diagram; electrical safety checklist; transformer inspection record; mock fault-reporting exercise.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: State electricity distribution companies, power utilities, railways and public-sector electrical establishments when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Power distribution contractors, transmission and distribution EPC companies, electrical infrastructure firms and maintenance contractors.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Line maintenance, cable installation, equipment inspection, fault response and distribution-network safety.
Find current opportunities through Apprenticeship India and the relevant utility’s official recruitment page. Apprenticeship availability does not guarantee permanent employment.
Directorate General of Training

blocks.label: Progression route
blocks.text: Field experience + required qualifications → Senior Technician / Line Supervisor, where eligible.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Government lineman vacancies may have separate age, medical fitness, trade-certificate and selection requirements. Always follow the specific recruitment notification.
Relevant programmes

items.text: Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
Advanced vocational training in power distribution and electrical maintenance.
Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS), subject to eligibility, for vocational-instructor careers.

blocks.text: Institutions / resources

items.text: National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), where relevant programmes are available.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Overhead distribution lines, underground cables, transformers, distribution fault response, substation support and renewable-energy grid connections.

items.text: With relevant experience and authorization: Line Supervisor / Electrical Supervisor

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Electricity distribution, power utilities, infrastructure, electrical contracting, renewable energy and industrial maintenance.
Job titles and qualifications differ by employer. Supervisory and licensed roles may require additional credentials.
Technical skills
Tools / technologies
Useful qualifications

items.text: Relevant DGT / NCVT-recognized electrical trade certificate.
Registered apprenticeship completion / National Apprenticeship Certificate, where applicable.
First aid, rescue and working-at-height training where required.

blocks.label: Safety rule
blocks.text: Never climb poles, approach energized lines or perform live-line work without the required authorization, training, PPE and approved utility procedures.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.

Common requirements

items.text: English or German proficiency where required.
Local apprenticeship, qualification assessment or licensing requirements.
Safety and medical requirements for particular field roles.

blocks.text: An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically authorize power-line work overseas. Confirm current course entry, qualification recognition and local requirements.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Power-Line Technician, Distribution Lineworker, Electrical Field Technician, Line Maintenance Technician.

blocks.label: Markets
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.
Requirements for licensing, safety training, language proficiency and work authorization vary by jurisdiction. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Reminder
blocks.text: Before admission or applying for a lineman vacancy, verify the current trade eligibility, ITI affiliation, utility-specific qualifications, medical standards, safety training and recruitment notification.
